name: SLS4D
aliases: Sparse Latent Space for 4D Novel View Synthesis
definition: SLS4D is a sparse latent space representation for 4D novel view synthesis that replaces dense voxel grids with learnable latent codes to reduce parameters while capturing global dynamics.
summary: SLS4D is a sparse latent space representation for 4D novel view synthesis that reduces parameters by 94% compared to prior work by using learnable latent codes instead of dense voxel grids.
